_readme: T97 picks: per card, the candidate my person picked for each prop, and their words. model_view.png in each prop folder is the pick (or its edit).

glowing_briefcase.words: Briefcase: "The brief case should be on it's side, be open, and be glowing god rays out.", "2 needs to be more like a briefcase. So flatter but wide. Think of a lawyers case in NY", "Reduce the height of the case.", "Do 2 but have the case's lid slightly open", "The brief case is hinging on the wrong side.", a reference photo of an open attache case, then "Take 1, approve card 5". The set as recommended otherwise: watch 1 with its numbers cleared ("Raise the cap to 700"), milkshake 2, burger 2.

picks.glowing_briefcase: round 8 take 1 (concept.png; model_view.png is an edit without the rays)

pick_a_pill.words: Pills 2, phone 1, redo the spoon (Recommended); then "The spoon should be bent like this" with a reference; then "30°, approve card 7 (Recommended)"

picks.bent_spoon: round 3 take 1, bent 30° at the neck by bend_spoon.swift (r4_bend/bend_30.png)
